name: Yoga Bar Millet Muesli
ingredients: Whole Grains 58.0% (Millets 26.0% (Ragi 16%, Jowar 10%), Rolled Oats 22%, Brown Rice Flakes), Corn Flakes (Corn Grits, Unrefined Sugar, Iodized Salt, Malt Extract, Soy Lecithin), Nuts & Seeds 9.5% (Flax, Pumpkin, Almond), Rice Crispy, Dehydrated Fruits 4.8% (Raisins, Cranberry), Jaggery Syrup, Honey, Rice Bran Oil, Natural Flavors (Almond, Rosemary Extract), Himalayan Pink Salt.
